correctness.rationale: The support permutation argument proves that fixed-base vertical hypersurfaces are the only periodic prime divisors. Applying the infinite-orbit divisor-indeterminacy obstruction to a hypothetical stable model leaves finitely many invariant contracted divisors, whose deletion is F-invariant and factorial. The divisor localization sequence for a smooth rational projective model has kernel generated by moving torus characters, fixed-base characters, and removed fixed-base irreducibles. The corresponding pullback is A plus identity blocks. A nonnegative boundary pullback matrix must therefore have a dominant nonreal peripheral eigenvalue with non-torsion argument, contrary to Perron--Frobenius. The exact checker verifies the explicit A input, not the universal statement. Proof independently reconstructs the nonstandard boundary argument from effective resolution pullback. Assumptions include complex characteristic zero, smooth projective model, irreducible cubic spectrum and every r>=1.
